messages:
Maya (CSM): morning — quick QuantaPay weekly check-in. Hosted API spend is ~+38% vs committed weekly run rate, spend-bot flagged it at 06:12 :eyes:
RedwoodBot: Automated spend alert for QuantaPay (acct: QP-112): +38% vs 7d baseline. Top contributor: embeddings endpoint (embed_text_v2) — 85k units in 1hr window. Recent deploy: none.
Jordan (CS Ops): noted. Their onboarding enablement was Mon/Wed — could be test workloads. Any evidence of automated replay loops?
Maya (CSM): they did run a bulk migration script last night per notes from AM. Priya, did you get details on the script?
Priya (AE): they mentioned a one-off index build + sample evaluation run. I asked for the manifest but haven’t got it yet. Reaching out now.
Sam (SRE): I can scan the request logs for repeating request IDs and abnormally long sequences. Send me 1-2 sample request IDs or a time window.
Maya (CSM): sample window: 1951234400-1951234600. Example request id from their dashboard: req_8f3a7c2b.
Sam (SRE): thx. Running quick grep -> found ~12k calls from a single pod IP (10.12.5.23) hitting /v1/embeddings in that window. Suspect a misconfigured batch job.
Jordan (CS Ops): can you paste the log snippet?
Sam (SRE): "2026-09-12T06:34:12Z req=req_8f3a7c2b ip=10.12.5.23 path=/v1/embeddings model=embed_text_v2 tokens=1024 status=200 duration_ms=120"
Sam (SRE): pattern: same user_id and almost identical input length repeated -> likely a looped job.
Luca (Finance): if this is a one-off, we can do a courtesy credit for the excess and reset alerts. If it's ongoing, we should throttle/quota to prevent invoice surprise. Recommend temporary quota: embeddings 100k units/day for QuantaPay until we confirm.
Priya (AE): I told the customer to pause their migration job; waiting on their confirm. If they paused, we can revert quotas.
Maya (CSM): action items: 1) Sam to block / rate-limit offending IP (temp) 2) Jordan to annotate account with incident note + link to spend spikes 3) Luca to hold a provisional credit plan 4) Priya to confirm with customer and capture root cause for renewal notes.
Sam (SRE): started a rate-limit rollout to that IP: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/rate-limits -d '{"ip":"10.12.5.23","limit":1000}'` -> applied. Will monitor.
Jordan (CS Ops): adding thread to account timeline and creating a short ticket: CSOPS-7124.
Luca (Finance): provisional credit plan: up to $1.2k one-time credit if root cause is internal testing/migration; escalate to billing if they request more.
Priya (AE): customer replied — they paused the job and will run a trimmed test first. They appreciate the quick catch.
Maya (CSM): excellent. For onboarding notes: please record that enablement ran additional evaluation scripts not covered in the ramp plan. We should add a short checklist to prevent future surprises.
Jordan (CS Ops): proposed checklist item: "Has customer scheduled bulk runs? If yes, validate expected token units and pre-authorize additional spend"
Maya (CSM): captured. Also logging customer feedback: asked them for clearer labels on test jobs — they said internal teams mislabeled prod/test which caused the loop.
Priya (AE): renewal risk: temporary, low if credits applied and quotas help prevent surprises. I'll update the renewal scorecard to "monitor" rather than "at-risk".
Sam (SRE): monitoring metrics now show embeddings traffic returning to baseline after rate-limit. Will keep watch for 24h.
Luca (Finance): once we confirm one-off, I'll issue the credit and close finance side.
Maya (CSM): thanks team. Follow-ups: Sam/Jordan/Luca — please update comments in CSOPS-7124. Priya — confirm customer pauses in the next 2 hours. I'll run a quick post-mortem checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): will do.
RedwoodBot: Spend monitor cleared for QuantaPay, anomaly window closed at 06:58.
Maya (CSM): closing thread for now — will re-open if spikes resume"
